statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∀ X : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ E X, H X n = ∑ p ∈ P X, ((E X).filter (fun n => p≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card

plain_statement.zh: 将两步路径的一阶矩换成逐个小素数求和
plain_statement.en: Double-count first arrivals by their small prime step

brief.zh: 交换终点和第一步的求和顺序，使不同小素数可以共用长区间素数下界。
brief.en: Count the same incidences in the opposite order so each small prime can use a common long-interval estimate.
